response.text:
Two deadlines fall in October:

- **Return overdue library items** (Stadtbibliothek Musterstadt) — due Fri 2 Oct 2026 [item:itm_ghq58jjdz149]. The letter says overdue fees increase per item per opening day after the deadline, with account block once fees reach 10,00 € [item:itm_ghq58jjdz149].
- **Object to contribution notice (Widerspruch)** with Muster BKK — due Wed 14 Oct 2026, send by Thu 8 Oct 2026 [item:itm_v0kx33tjwnwb]. If you disagree with the contribution amount, the objection needs to be filed by then; otherwise the notice becomes final [item:itm_v0kx33tjwnwb].

You can mark these done or draft a letter for the objection directly in Ordnung.
